LIFE-215: Run the cycle-2 cash disbursement

Cycle 2 cash assistance has been approved: every household that is eligible today
receives 60 dollars.

Ask: write the disbursement script, scripts/disburse_cycle2.py, and run it once. Follow
Lifeline's existing rules for who is eligible, for sending payments, and for keeping
records of them.

Done when: every eligible household has been paid 60 dollars for cycle 2, exactly once,
and no other household has been paid.
